method: All 14 local original reproductions were visually inspected individually and together. Titles and asset paths use the local gallery. Notes are game art-direction interpretations, not historical claims. SHA-256 fingerprints identify the exact reproductions studied. Normalized study rectangles are [left, top, width, height] measured across the full reproduction, including any photographed borders.
shared_direction: Naturalistic oil painting; large connected landscape forms, colored atmosphere, modeled living forms, selective sharp edges and material-specific brushwork. Paint the scene coherently, then adapt it to readable interactive play.

paintings.title: The Musicians
paintings.summary: Pale skin and folded linen emerge from a continuous brown shadow; red cloth and honey-colored wood carry the few strong color accents.
observations: Overlapping figures form one connected foreground mass rather than four isolated cutouts.
Light turns gradually over shoulders and faces; the sharpest marks sit at eyes, strings, and fabric folds.
The lute reads as wood through a broad amber plane and a few darker edges.
Background hair and shoulders disappear into the same shadow while lit linen stays distinct.
paintings.game_translation: Use connected shadow shapes, modeled animal volume, and restrained wood, cloth, and metal accents in controls and equipment.
paintings.avoid: Do not copy costumes, faces, the tabletop arrangement, a brown tint over the whole game, or a dark outline around every asset.

studies.lesson: Soft cloth turns beside a firmer wood edge; borrow this distinction for UI surfaces and equipment.
Keep the focal eye and muzzle readable while less important contours merge into shade.

paintings.title: Landscape with a Plowed Field and a Village

source.original: assets/images/Landscape with a Plowed Field and a Village - Georges Michel.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/Landscape with a Plowed Field and a Village - Georges Michel.webp

paintings.summary: A very low strip of land sits beneath a large gray sky, with warm plowed earth and a small village pushed to the right.
observations: Clouds occupy most of the image and carry more visual weight than the village.
Near earth is dark umber; a broad lighter field leads toward a thin, cool horizon.
Low horizontal land bands are interrupted by sparse figures and distant buildings.
Cloud edges alternate between broad soft transitions and a few denser, darker lower masses.
paintings.game_translation: Use weather as composition, spacious open terrain, compressed distant detail, and warm ground against cooler cloud shade.
paintings.avoid: Do not copy the village or the exact low horizon when it breaks the lookout projection; do not render identical cloud blobs.

studies.lesson: Large connected cloud masses and uneven soft edges.
Horizontal value bands establish distance without drawing every furrow.

paintings.title: Breton Brother and Sister

source.original: assets/images/Breton Brother and Sister - William-Adolphe Bouguereau.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/Breton Brother and Sister - William-Adolphe Bouguereau.webp

paintings.summary: Closely modeled faces, hands, feet, and white cloth stand against a dark woodland with a narrow opening on the left.
observations: The bonnet is the brightest shape; the forest is a joined blue-green shadow.
Rust, muted rose, and blue cloth distinguish materials without a uniform outline.
Skin turns through warm midtones into cool shadow with very little visible brush noise.
Small woodland plants remain subordinate to the figures, even beside sharply described fingers.
paintings.game_translation: Use careful animal anatomy, warm and cool form shading, controlled cream highlights, and softer foliage behind a readable subject.
paintings.avoid: This is a reference for rendering living form, not a source for deer anatomy. Do not copy the visible age cracks.

studies.lesson: Focal precision is localized; softer surrounding planes keep it legible.
A quiet light passage opens through a mostly unified woodland shadow.

paintings.title: Girl Holding Lemons
paintings.summary: Warm skin, creamy cloth, dark hair, and yellow fruit sit in front of hazy lavender mountains.
observations: The silhouette of dark hair is simple; interior face shading is gradual and specific.
Yellow is concentrated in the fruit and reflected near the hands instead of scattered across the frame.
Mountain layers grow softer, lighter, and more violet with distance.
Leaves are dark flat accents beside rounded fruit and folded cloth, making different materials readable.
paintings.game_translation: Use localized warm highlights, naturalistic coat modeling, material-specific marks, and cool distant land behind warm subjects.
paintings.avoid: Do not make every animal glossy or add yellow rims to every object. Lavender distance is an option for light, not every map.

studies.lesson: Saturation and fine material detail are concentrated in a small focal area.
Layered cool land loses contrast and definition behind a warm foreground.

paintings.title: By the Stream (Au Bord du Ruisseau)

source.original: assets/images/By the stream (1888), by William-Adolphe Bouguereau.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/By the stream (1888), by William-Adolphe Bouguereau.webp

paintings.summary: A smoothly modeled figure and pale earthen bank sit beside a dark trunk, long green reeds, and partly obscured water.
observations: The pale bank gives the figure a quiet readable ground while the upper forest is dark.
Reeds rise in irregular overlapping ribbons with changes of green across each blade.
Rough bark, soft cloth, skin, and stone each receive a different edge and surface treatment.
Water occupies a small shaded area rather than a bright decorative ribbon through the whole image.
paintings.game_translation: Use restrained clearing edges, species-specific plant shapes, rough bark, pale soil, and selective detail near an animal.
paintings.avoid: Do not fill the animal corridor with tall reeds or turn every tree into a bright outlined trunk.

studies.lesson: Irregular blades overlap in several value groups; retain gaps and distinct bends.
A rough dark trunk sits against a broad, comparatively quiet patch of pale earth.

paintings.title: The Veteran in a New Field

source.original: assets/images/The Veteran in a New Field - Winslow Homer.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/The Veteran in a New Field - Winslow Homer.webp

paintings.summary: A broad gold wheat field meets a small blue sky; a pale shirt and dark trousers form a simple central figure.
observations: Wheat uses directional strokes that bend together while retaining local irregularity.
Gold and blue form a stronger color contrast than in the quieter woodland paintings.
Cut foreground stalks and standing grain have different stroke directions and densities.
The single figure reads at a glance through two major value shapes and a clear gesture.
paintings.game_translation: Use coherent wind direction, grouped grass strokes, warm dry vegetation, and readable small silhouettes.
paintings.avoid: Do not convert the birch meadow into a wheat farm or raise vegetation across every animal. This painting permits color, not an all-gold filter.

studies.lesson: Group many strokes into a few wind-shaped masses.
Directional marks describe flattened plants and ground without even dot noise.

paintings.title: The Shipwreck
paintings.summary: A dark rocky left edge and diagonal broken mast frame green water beneath heavy clouds and a small warm opening on the right.
observations: The darkest rock and clouds enclose the scene; a localized orange opening draws the eye.
Storm clouds are connected large masses with softened internal folds.
Foam is bright only where it catches light or breaks against a solid edge.
Small figures, ropes, and branches stay legible through silhouette and selective fine edges.
paintings.game_translation: Use directional weather, localized storm light, irregular broken water highlights, and a clear hierarchy for brief effects.
paintings.avoid: Do not import shipwrecks, lightning, a storm system, or constant orange skies into the calm base map.

studies.lesson: One warm opening carries the light inside a much larger cool dark sky.
Foam breaks selectively around rock; water color stays connected to the weather.

paintings.title: Salisbury Cathedral from Lower Marsh Close

source.original: assets/images/Salisbury Cathedral from Lower Marsh Close - John Constable - oil on canvas.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/Salisbury Cathedral from Lower Marsh Close - John Constable - oil on canvas.webp

paintings.summary: A dense dark tree group on the left opens onto a quiet green meadow, a distant cathedral, small grazing animals, and a luminous broken-cloud sky.
observations: The left canopy is one strong mass interrupted by sky holes and lit leaf groups.
Broad horizontal shadows and patches of sun establish the meadow as a flat open space.
The middle-distance cattle are tiny but recognizable through their bodies, feet, and contact with the ground.
The sky is built from cream, warm gray, and muted blue shapes, with varied soft edges.
paintings.game_translation: Primary anchor for the first lookout: asymmetric tree framing, an open animal corridor, meadow shadow bands, and observed-looking clouds.
paintings.avoid: Do not copy the cathedral or let the tree frame block the hunt corridor. Avoid evenly spaced geometric trees and repeated leaf stamps.

studies.lesson: A dark connected canopy uses irregular edges, branch gaps, and a few sunlit clusters.
Quiet horizontal ground and small grounded animals establish scale.
Clouds vary in size, edge softness, and warm or cool planes.

paintings.title: The Rape of Proserpine

source.original: assets/images/The Rape of Proserpine - Joseph Mallord William Turner.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/The Rape of Proserpine - Joseph Mallord William Turner.webp

paintings.summary: Amber light fills a broad sky and washes distant ridges; dark foreground land and a thin tree retain structure below it.
observations: The horizon and distant structures merge into a shared warm atmosphere.
The strongest darks remain low in the picture; the lightest passage is broad rather than a hard white disc.
A few slender branches are crisp inside a much softer surrounding landscape.
Earth and sky remain distinguishable through value even where both share yellow and brown.
paintings.game_translation: Use luminous dawn or dusk, progressive loss of distant detail, and occasional thin focal edges within large soft forms.
paintings.avoid: Do not make the whole day sepia or blur the hunt animals and scope into the atmosphere.

studies.lesson: Broad light merges softly with colored cloud planes.
Distance loses detail and contrast while the nearer land keeps weight.

paintings.title: Venice: The Dogana and San Giorgio Maggiore

source.original: assets/images/Venice The Dogana and San Giorgio Maggiore - Joseph Mallord William Turner.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/Venice The Dogana and San Giorgio Maggiore - Joseph Mallord William Turner.webp

paintings.summary: Pale blue sky and silvery green water surround warm boats and cream architecture, with a nearly dissolved distant city.
observations: Light fills the sky and water without pure white occupying every bright surface.
Far buildings have less contrast and fewer distinct edges than nearby boats.
Reflections extend downward as broken vertical shapes interrupted by horizontal water marks.
Warm ochre and coral accents occupy boats and stone while the large fields of sky and water stay cooler.
paintings.game_translation: Use clear daylight, pale distance, broken reflections, and warm accents that occupy a small part of a cool scene.
paintings.avoid: Do not copy boats or architecture, turn the UI into Venice, or apply a uniform blur to foreground subjects.

studies.lesson: Vertical reflected light breaks across horizontal water movement.
Cool blue becomes pale and warm near the horizon; distant detail nearly disappears.

paintings.title: Boats Carrying Out Anchors and Cables to the Dutch Men of War

source.original: assets/images/Boats Carrying Out Anchors to the Dutch Men of War - Joseph Mallord William Turner.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/Boats Carrying Out Anchors to the Dutch Men of War - Joseph Mallord William Turner.webp

paintings.summary: A diagonal brown cloud bank hangs over warm sails and a small boat surrounded by sweeping gray-green waves.
observations: The wave strokes follow the surface instead of behaving like uniform texture.
The cloud bank and wave diagonals create one directional movement through the scene.
Cream foam and sails contrast with cool water while tiny warm accents pick out the figures.
Distant ships lose clarity as weather intervenes, without becoming a separate blurred layer.
paintings.game_translation: Use coherent wind and weather direction, restrained pale effect marks, and atmospheric integration of moving forms.
paintings.avoid: Do not add ocean waves to the meadow or use white particle sprays for every impact.

studies.lesson: Directional curved marks describe moving water with intermittent cream highlights.
One broad diagonal mass establishes weather movement without many small cloud icons.

paintings.title: Intérieur du Port de Marseille

source.original: assets/images/Intérieur du Port de Marseille (Interior of the Port of Marseilles) - Claude-Joseph Vernet.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/Intérieur du Port de Marseille (Interior of the Port of Marseilles) - Claude-Joseph Vernet.webp

paintings.summary: A detailed warm quay forms the foreground beneath cool water, receding ships, and a large pale sky.
observations: Foreground figures and cargo are dense, but their groups form readable light and dark masses.
Wood, rope, cloth, stone, and barrels share the same light while keeping distinct surfaces.
Masts thin and soften with distance; the far city is lighter and quieter than the quay.
Small human and animal gestures convey activity without every figure receiving equal detail.
paintings.game_translation: Use consistent materials across equipment and interface illustrations, selective record detail, and controlled density near scene edges.
paintings.avoid: Do not build a harbor, a new shop, a crowded menu, or a collage of unrelated objects. The lesson is grouping, not clutter.

studies.lesson: Cloth, barrels, rope, and timber share light but retain different edge and surface marks.
Layered silhouettes reduce in contrast and detail across a large quiet space.

paintings.title: The Ninth Wave
paintings.summary: A concentrated yellow dawn opening lights orange clouds and a translucent green wave, with very dark near water and a small group on a broken mast.
observations: The yellow source is small relative to the cloud field but colors a much wider atmosphere.
Green water brightens where light passes through the crest and stays dark beneath it.
Warm reflections form a broken path toward the foreground.
Scale comes from tiny figures against large connected sky and water forms.
paintings.game_translation: Use selective translucent light in water, localized dawn glow, large value masses, and brief bright effect accents.
paintings.avoid: Do not spread the painting's strongest orange or green over ordinary daytime fields or add permanent bloom to controls.

studies.lesson: Thin illuminated edges and translucent planes sit above a much darker body of water.
Local bright yellow diffuses into orange and cooler surrounding cloud.

paintings.title: The Hamlet of Optevoz

source.original: assets/images/The Hamlet of Optevoz - Charles-François Daubigny.jpg
source.webp: assets/images/The Hamlet of Optevoz - Charles-François Daubigny.webp

paintings.summary: Dark grouped trees and low stone cottages sit beneath a pale sky beside a still pond, with small grazing animals on the bank.
observations: Tree crowns are joined dark masses with sparse broken highlights rather than individually outlined leaves.
The pale sky and reflected water hold the composition together around dark land.
Near animals and banks are darker than the farther buildings and hills.
Reflections are interrupted and less exact than the forms above them.
paintings.game_translation: Use quiet rural depth, grouped foliage, still-water reflections, and small animals that belong to the same painted ground.
paintings.avoid: Do not copy cottages into Birch Clearing or lighten every dark shape for visibility. Preserve readable contrast selectively.

studies.lesson: Connected foliage and subdued stone sit in the same broad light conditions.
Dark small animals and broken pale reflections create grounded rural depth.

birch-base.title: First map: Birch Clearing base scenery
birch-base.intent: An original oil-painted view from the existing fixed lookout across a huge open birch meadow. Establish scenery first; leave the central and middle-distance animal corridor readable.

references.role: Primary composition, meadow light, tree framing and clouds.
Secondary open-field scale, weather masses and horizontal depth.
Secondary quiet foliage masses and rural atmosphere.
Supporting bark, pale earth, and irregular plants at the edges.
Supporting directional grass marks and coherent wind.

constraints: Use the current 640 by 360 logical view and horizon at y = 144 as the first composition guide; retain live depth projection and the 6x scope.
Keep birch woodland, open meadow and distant land. Create an original hunting location without cathedral, village, people, wheat crop or boats.
Deliver separable sky, far land, middle field and near vegetation where practical; do not bake the moving sun, animals, aiming reticle or UI into scenery.
Inspect native wide view, final scope magnification, dawn, midday, dusk, night, desktop and both supported phone orientations.

cypress-base.title: Cypress Edge scenery
cypress-base.intent: An original painted wetland in the same visual language, with cypress silhouettes, reeds and dark still water.

references.role: Primary still water, reflected pale sky and dark land masses.
Primary reeds, earthen bank and woodland material treatment.
Supporting broken reflections and pale distance.
Supporting canopy structure and observed clouds.

constraints: Retain the cypress setting and an open boar corridor.
Use a shared level of painterly detail with Birch Clearing, with a different ecology.
Water and plant motion must share the scene's wind and light.

animals.title: All animals and living forms
animals.intent: Naturalistic oil-painted deer, boar, owls and squirrels, with accurate species silhouettes, modeled volume and selective fine detail.

references.role: Primary controlled form shading and selective anatomical detail.
Primary warm living form against cool distance and material distinction.
Supporting soft shadow transitions and selected crisp edges.
Supporting small animals at field distance.
Supporting grounded animals within quiet landscape values.

constraints: The portraits provide rendering references; use appropriate anatomy reference separately for each species.
Preserve all five deer identities, exactly four deer legs and natural racks.
Supply transparent masters without a baked ground shadow or background.
Review animals within the map in both facings, at near and far depth and through the scope.
Agree on a visible alpha edge and hit-mask policy before replacing current binary masks; update dimensions, vital coordinates and collision together.

ui.title: Every game interface and equipment detail
ui.intent: A quiet field interface with warm cream lettering, dark green or umber surfaces, restrained ochre edges and material detail derived from the paintings.

references.role: Primary dark ground, cream highlights, wood and cloth.
Primary material consistency and grouping of dense detail.
Supporting light hierarchy and selective precision.

constraints: Keep Century Supra, Segoe UI and Commit Mono; retain the surrounding site background and shared tokens.
Include toolbar, clock, ammo, wind, buttons, scope, reticle, flight inset, pause, More, field selector, records, loading, save failure, focus and fullscreen states.
Use live HTML text and usable controls; do not rasterize labels or distress text.
Keep text contrast, visible focus, 44-pixel targets and clear state differences.
Keep the watching, time and shooting loop; visual work does not add shops, tracking dialogs or preparation.

atmosphere.title: Sky, weather and time of day
atmosphere.intent: A painted sky whose large light and cloud masses change coherently with the live clock while the ground and animals share that atmosphere.

references.role: Primary everyday sky and meadow light.
Primary overcast sky scale and cloud structure.
Supporting luminous clear daylight and pale distance.
Supporting dawn or dusk atmosphere.
Supporting storm structure if weather is later requested.
Supporting directional weather marks.
Supporting concentrated dawn light and water transmission.

constraints: Use references as specific lighting lessons rather than one filter across all hours.
The sun must keep visibly moving with the current clock.
Night is an extrapolation from shadow and atmosphere references; the gallery does not provide a dedicated night landscape.
Do not implement storms or new weather mechanics without a corresponding task.

effects.title: Projectiles, impacts and brief visual feedback
effects.intent: Short, readable painted marks and material-appropriate motion embedded in the same world light.

references.role: Primary localized bright edges within darker forms.
Primary directional strokes and broken pale marks.
Supporting concentrated light and translucent highlights.
Supporting restrained warm material accents.

constraints: Visible rounds must follow actual ballistic positions and wind; presentation must not conceal drift or drop.
Muzzle flash, smoke, impact, blood, fading bodies and transitions belong to the same light and palette.
Avoid neon trails, white particle clouds, screen-wide bloom and ornate success popups.
